disputes.our_call: Budget 200 hours for the platinum and expect it to run as high as 300 if you take your time.
disputes.title: How long is the platinum?

versions.text: Around 200 hours, most of it on the 100% checklist.
Up to 300 hours or more, with the story alone at 60-80 hours.

disputes.our_call: Use about 100 hours of post-story checklist work; the 200-hour figure counts the story too.
disputes.title: How long does 100% take?

versions.text: About 200 hours for the 100% checklist on its own.

disputes.our_call: 28 hidden, per PSNProfiles, TrueTrophies and GTABase.
disputes.title: How many trophies are hidden on PSN?

versions.text: 27 are hidden — Personal Best is not marked hidden.

disputes.our_call: 200 of the 277 base models; Standout vehicles do not count.
disputes.title: Which vehicles count toward 100%?

disputes.our_call: 50 of 91 stick-ups, per two guides and the checklist.
disputes.title: How many stick-ups does 100% need?

disputes.our_call: $250,000 — it matches the Dime on the Dollar trophy itself.
disputes.title: How much Marked Bills laundering does 100% need?

disputes.our_call: 90 hoops, matching PowerPyx, GTABase and KeenGamer.
disputes.title: How many basketball hoops does 100% need?

disputes.our_call: Keep cheats off the trophy save entirely; don't risk a session you can't undo.
disputes.title: Do cheats block trophies?

versions.text: Cheats disable trophy unlocks and saving while active.
The block lasts only for the current session; reloading a clean save restores eligibility.
Not known yet whether cheats block trophies at all.

disputes.our_call: The official text wins: it is the Chapter 5 finale.
disputes.title: What does the gold story trophy ask for?

disputes.our_call: Silver, per the official list and every other guide.
disputes.title: What grade is Maximum Withdrawal?

disputes.our_call: Unconfirmed — try the rooftop bar as a lead, but don't trust it until players confirm it.
disputes.title: Where does In The Beginning… trigger?

versions.text: Trigger unknown; no confirmed steps yet.
Ocean View Rooftop Bar on Ocean Beach.

disputes.our_call: PowerPyx — the in-game checklist has no stranger line.
disputes.title: Does Strangers & Freaks count toward 100%?

disputes.our_call: The weights don't change what to do — trust the in-game menu.
disputes.title: How is the 100% checklist weighted?

versions.text: Story & tasks 45%, exploration & activities 45%, discovery 10% (eGamers and gamemapa, attributed to GTABase).
Story 50%, tasks 27%, exploration 20%, discovery 3% (GTABase's own 100% guide).
Story 50%, optional tasks 6%, and 1% per other category.

disputes.our_call: Protect the Chapter 1 meditation anyway — it costs nothing and may save a replay.
disputes.title: Is anything missable?

versions.text: Possibly one: the Chapter 1 balcony meditation.

disputes.our_call: Use the official spelling exactly as PlayStation publishes it.
disputes.title: How is the Chapter 4 trophy spelled?

disputes.our_call: 12 story trophies; the other 16 hidden trophies are side content.
disputes.title: How many hidden trophies are story-related?

versions.text: 12 story trophies and 16 hidden side trophies.

disputes.our_call: Gamerscore is Xbox-only; this guide tracks PS5 grades, so it does not apply.
disputes.title: Why do Gamerscore values differ between lists?

versions.text: Lists disagree on Gamerscore values, so some leave them out.

disputes.our_call: Allow 10-20 hours for the cleanup stage.
disputes.title: How long does the cleanup stage take?

disputes.our_call: Do all 18 meditations — the trophy needs them even though 100% doesn't.
disputes.title: 18 meditations or 15?

disputes.our_call: Coffee Break — both partner trophies need the duo roaming together, which the guides tie to Coffee Break.
disputes.title: When does partner free-roam unlock?

versions.text: After the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break.
After the Chapter 2 mission Breakfast Run.

disputes.our_call: The WAiNK method has four guides behind it; try it first, and if it doesn't register, try the Moses route.
disputes.title: How do you register vehicles for On the Spot?

versions.text: Find a scooter and scan it with the WAiNK app to register it.
Take eligible stolen vehicles to Moses in Port Gellhorn and choose Respray, then Register.

note: Where our sources disagree, we show both sides and say what this guide does. Each dispute is written in our own words from the numbered sources in sources.json.
